name: Man Of Culture
source:
Life is beautiful!

So much colors and events that can  make anyone happy!

Anyone but you. Your life is a bleak and lifeless mass of days, one after the other.

Or so you thought... 

Until you've learned of a wonderful world of 'femboys'~

[From [url=https://mryourass.itch.io/man-of-culture]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活多么美好！

五彩缤纷，趣事不断，足以让任何人感到快乐！

唯独你不行。你的人生只是一天天黯淡而死气沉沉的日子，不断重复。

至少，你原本是这么想的……

直到你发现了“女装男孩”这个美妙的世界。
